title: Quantum Levitation
channel: Association of Science and Technology Centers
summary: A short demo from Tel-Aviv University of a superconductor locked in a magnetic field, hovering and staying fixed in place. It was shown at the 2011 ASTC conference.
why: Linked in superconductivity and levitation threads as the canonical quantum locking demo.

quote.text: All other instances of “quantum levitation” that I have seen has a “locked in” effect
